easy: Having snow falling or snow on the ground.

easy: Two ideas or things that clash because they cannot both be true.

easy: Being strong and able to last a long time without breaking.

ex.en: The durability of these boots is great for hiking.

easy: A woman who rules an empire, or the wife of an emperor.

ex.en: The empress lived in a huge palace.

easy: A person whose job is to make people laugh or enjoy a show.

ex.en: The entertainer made the kids laugh at the party.

ex.en: She was a finalist in the spelling bee.

easy: A small tool or machine that is handy for a job.

easy: The first page you see when you open a website.

ex.en: Our school homepage shows the lunch menu.
ex.ko: 우리 학교 홈페이지에는 급식 메뉴가 나온다.

easy: Full of new and creative ideas.

ex.en: She wrote an imaginative story about a dragon.

easy: Not perfect; having a problem or a mistake.

ex.ko: 내 그림은 불완전하지만 나는 마음에 든다.

ex.en: We had an implicit rule to be quiet in the library.
ex.ko: 우리는 도서관에서 조용히 한다는 암묵적인 규칙이 있었다.

easy: Complete, with no doubts at all.

easy: Not caring about how other people feel.

easy: Making cloth or clothes by looping yarn with long needles.

ex.en: Grandma does knitting every evening.

ex.en: Mom rubbed lotion on my sunburn.

easy: A nobleman of high rank in some countries.

easy: By mistake, not on purpose.

easy: Sad because you miss home or the good old days.

easy: Very unfair and hard on people.

ex.en: The ground quaked during the earthquake.

ex.en: I have a toy racer on my shelf.
ex.ko: 나는 선반 위에 장난감 경주용 자동차가 있다.

ex.en: The teacher gave a quick recap of the story.

easy: Going out to look around and learn what is there.

easy: The side of a road.

easy: In a way that uses science.

easy: All mixed up and not in order.

easy: To join cloth together using a needle and thread.

easy: Making pain or sore skin feel better.

easy: A person who takes care of a house or things for someone else.

easy: Found not guilty by a judge.

ex.ko: 그 남자는 무죄 판결을 받고 집으로 돌아갔다.

easy: Made by people, not by nature.

easy: A tiny ball with a hole for a string.

ex.en: I put a red bead on the bracelet.

easy: Not being able to see.

ex.en: Blindness does not stop her from reading with braille.
